mentions.name: SRS story-world language learning app
mentions.description: This language learning app tracks spaced-repetition (SRS) study items and builds stories in worlds the user can create to help review them, combining features the author wanted as a language learner with their favorite aspects of other language apps.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on a language learning app.

At its most basic it keeps track of all your SRS-y things for you and builds stories in worlds you can create to help review them, but it's so much more.
